integrity: The proof is self-contained and uses only the finite-field torsion-unit observation, the parametrization of the nilpotent cone, and a determinant count. Exhaustive finite-field checks are consistency tests, not substitutes for the proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved only for \(2\times2\) matrices; higher-dimensional nilpotent cones have different geometry.

The literature comparison found no exact decomposition-count theorem, but older finite-field convolution or matrix-enumeration literature could contain an equivalent count under different terminology.
title: Exact t-fine decomposition multiplicities for two-by-two finite-field matrices
